title: Writing Task 2 - Animal Testing
description: IELTS Writing Task 2: To what extent do you agree or disagree that animal testing for medical research is justified?

stimuli.title: Task 2: Animal Testing in Medical Research
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

Some people believe that experimenting on animals for medical research is a necessary and justified practice, while others argue that it is cruel and should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree that animal testing is justified?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questionGroups.instruction: Write an essay giving your opinion on whether animal testing for medical research is justified.

questions.content: To what extent do you agree or disagree that animal testing for medical research is justified?

bandDescriptors.taskResponse: State a clear position and support it consistently with relevant arguments and examples
bandDescriptors.coherence: Develop arguments logically, using clear paragraph organisation and cohesive devices
bandDescriptors.lexicalResource: Use precise scientific and ethical vocabulary: clinical trials, vivisection, alternatives, ethics
bandDescriptors.grammaticalRange: Demonstrate complex structures: passive voice for scientific processes, modal verbs for obligation

sampleIdeas: Animal testing has led to life-saving vaccines and treatments, including polio vaccines and insulin
Animals cannot consent and may experience significant suffering during experiments
Modern alternatives such as cell cultures and computer modelling can replace some animal tests
Strict regulations in many countries minimise unnecessary animal suffering
